concepts.title: Linear combination of vectors
concepts.description: A finite sum a₁v₁+⋯+aₙvₙ of vectors multiplied by scalars from their vector space’s ground field; the empty sum is zero.

concepts.title: Perron–Frobenius theorem for nonnegative matrices
concepts.description: A nonnegative real matrix has a nonnegative eigenvalue equal to its spectral radius. If it is irreducible, that eigenvalue is simple and has a strictly positive eigenvector, unique up to scalar.

concepts.title: Spectral radius of a finite matrix
concepts.description: The maximum absolute value of the complex eigenvalues of the matrix.

concepts.title: Tensor product of vector spaces
concepts.description: The vector space V⊗W with its universal bilinear map from V×W.

concepts.title: Vector space
concepts.description: An abelian group with scalar multiplication by a field satisfying a(v+w)=av+aw, (a+b)v=av+bv, (ab)v=a(bv), and 1v=v.

concepts.title: Algebraic element of a field extension
concepts.description: An element α of L/F is algebraic over F if a nonzero polynomial in F[x] vanishes at α.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Balandraud’s uniform stabilizer theorem for sumsets
concepts.description: Fix a finite nonempty subset S of an abelian group. Either |S+T|≥|S|+|T|−1 for every finite nonempty T, or there is a finite nontrivial subgroup H, depending only on S, such that S+T+H=S+T for every T violating that bound.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Cokernel of a linear map
concepts.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its cokernel is the quotient W/im(f).
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Direct sum of vector spaces
concepts.description: The algebraic direct sum of a family of vector spaces consists of tuples with only finitely many nonzero coordinates, with coordinatewise operations.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Exact sequence of vector spaces
concepts.description: A sequence of linear maps is exact at a vector space if the image of the incoming map equals the kernel of the outgoing map; it is exact if this holds everywhere.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Finite-dimensional vector space
concepts.description: A vector space having a finite basis.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Subfield generated by a subset
concepts.description: For S⊆L in a field extension L/F, F(S) is the smallest subfield of L containing F and S.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Image of a linear map
concepts.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its image is the subspace {f(v):v∈V} of W.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Kernel of a linear map
concepts.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its kernel is the subspace {v∈V:f(v)=0}.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Kneser’s addition theorem for finite sumsets
concepts.description: For finite nonempty subsets A,B of an abelian group, |A+B|≥|A|+|B|−|H(A+B)|, where H(A+B) is the translation stabilizer of the sumset.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Hou–Leung–Xiang linear Kneser theorem
concepts.description: Let L/F be a field extension in which every element algebraic over F is separable. For nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspaces S,T⊆L, dim_F(ST)≥dim_F S+dim_F T−dim_F H(ST), where H(ST) is the stabilizer field of ST.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Linear span of a set of vectors
concepts.description: The subspace consisting of all finite linear combinations of a specified set of vectors.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Linearly independent family of vectors
concepts.description: A family of vectors is linearly independent if every finite linear combination equalling zero has all coefficients zero.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory
